🚀 NIVIS 1.5 - Complete SSVEP Implementation & Major Enhancements

🧠 NEW: Complete SSVEP (Steady-State Visual Evoked Potential) System

  • Visual Stimulus Designer: Drag-and-drop interface to create and position flickering stimuli
  • Real-Time Focus Simulation: Advanced focus controller with fatigue modeling and attention tracking
  • Multi-Frequency Support: Simultaneous stimuli at 8Hz, 12Hz, 15Hz, and custom frequencies
  • Visual Flickering: Real-time visual feedback with test mode for slower demonstration
  • Focus State Monitoring: Live focus detection with intensity tracking and target frequency identification
  • Performance Analytics: Real-time focus metrics, response times, and accuracy tracking

📊 Advanced Signal Processing & Analysis

  • Real-Time FFT Analysis: Power spectral density with frequency band overlays
  • Advanced Filtering: Low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, and notch filters with real-time preview
  • Artifact Detection: Automatic detection of eye blinks, motion, electrode pops, and powerline interference
  • Signal Quality Metrics: SNR calculation, artifact ratio, and frequency stability analysis
  • Connectivity Analysis: Phase coupling, amplitude coupling, and Granger causality

🎯 Professional Tutorials & Learning System

  • Comprehensive Tutorial Library: 12 detailed tutorials covering all major features
  • Interactive Learning: Step-by-step guides with difficulty levels and duration estimates
  • Search & Navigation: Easy-to-find tutorials with categorized sections
  • Example Projects: 10+ SSVEP demo projects showcasing real-world applications

🔧 Performance & User Experience Improvements

  • Window Management: Fixed performance issues and eliminated loading delays
  • Project System: Enhanced file-based project management with search and filtering
  • UI/UX Enhancements: Modern Apple-style interface with improved accessibility
  • Data Export: Enhanced CSV, JSON, HDF5, BDF, and EDF+ export capabilities
  • Real-Time Visualization: Improved oscilloscope, spectrogram, and topographic views

🏥 Healthcare & Research Applications

  • Clinical Research Tools: Research-grade data collection and analysis
  • Rehabilitation Systems: SSVEP-based therapy and training protocols
  • Diagnostic Support: Advanced signal processing for clinical assessment
  • Patient Monitoring: Real-time brain activity tracking and alerting

Performance Improvements: Sub-10ms latency, multi-channel support (1-64), scalable architecture for research to production workflows.

System Requirements: macOS 15.0 or later, 8GB RAM recommended for large datasets.
